facts.fact: The Countdown to 2030 / Global Financing Facility synthesis report analyses routinely reported national health facility data from DHIS2 for 2019-2024, with facility reports received from districts across the country.
The report gives national completeness of monthly facility reporting in DHIS2 as 99% of expected reports in 2024 (93% in 2019), with 99% of districts at or above 90% completeness in 2024.
